verdict.rationale: PayPal's Subscriptions API lets developers (and now AI agents via the agent toolkit) create recurring billing plans, free/discounted trials, and automated payment recovery, and invoicing supports automatic payment reminders — these are recurring, schedule-driven workflows exposed through agent tools like create/update/cancel subscription and create/list plans. However, this is scoped strictly to payment/billing recurrence, not a general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduler for arbitrary AI-native automation tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of a general cron-like scheduler or workflow automation engine beyond subscriptions/invoicing, and explicit documentation of an AI agent autonomously scheduling and re-triggering recurring workflows over time.
